study.title: Deep Learning for Brassica Oleracea Instance Segmentation in UAV Imagery
study.short_title: Mask R-CNN cabbage head instance segmentation (UAV)
study.venue: Image and Vision Computing New Zealand

segmentation.domain: crop (Brassica oleracea var. capitata cabbage heads) vs background
segmentation.best_model: Mask R-CNN (transfer learning from COCO): mAP 0.986

dataset.name: Mendeley Cabbages Dataset (Gifu Prefecture, Japan)
dataset.note: Public Mendeley dataset (doi:10.17632/5cp2dyjczk.1): UAV imagery of cabbage (Brassica oleracea var. capitata) over farmers' fields in Gifu Prefecture, Japan, full life cycle to pre-harvest; COCO-format pixel-level segmentation masks (semi-automated annotation); 458 images augmented to 1,100 (flips, rotations, exposure +/-10%, brightness +/-15%, salt-and-pepper noise 0.1%). Flight altitude not reported in text.

segmentation.backbone: Mask R-CNN (ResNet/ResNeXt + FPN, RPN, mask head)

mIoU.ambiguity: Instance-segmentation study; evaluated ONLY by mAP/precision/recall. No pixel-level segmentation metric reported.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class precision B = Brassica Oleracea ~0.96 (final) and recall ~0.95 (figure-only, Fig. 6); mAP50 (B) ending ~0.98, mAP50-95 (B) ~0.8 (Fig. 7 caption).

edge.framework: Mask R-CNN (Detectron-style; trained on Google Colab T4 GPU)

issues: Instance-segmentation study with mAP 0.986 as headline metric; no pixel-level segmentation metric => RQ1 semantic metrics not reportable.
Principal metric values (precision/recall/mAP50/mAP50-95 per class) reported as figure trends/captions (Fig. 6, 7), not tables; only headline mAP 0.986 given in prose.
Dataset is a public Mendeley dataset; flight altitude/GSD not reported in text.
Test image at 'greatest altitude' vs 'lowest zoom height' mentioned qualitatively only; confidence 71-86% on 38 detected cabbage instances in test image.
